title: No Determination | ASL | New Destination
description:
Israel-route flight to a NEW destination that AC has recently added. The new destination/contract is not yet fully configured in the DDS rules engine � route mappings, distance bands, or regime applicability rules may be incomplete. DDS cannot make a determination because the route configuration is missing or partial. Case routed for manual handling until the new destination is fully onboarded in the system.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger. Journey: Israel origin to a new destination recently added to AC's network. Route configuration: Incomplete or missing in DDS rules engine (new contract not fully onboarded). Regime: ASL applicable (Israel route) but DDS cannot fully assess due to missing route config.
